system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I am a farmer from a small village. We have been waiting for rain.
I understand. How can I help you today?
The crops are not doing well this year.
I am sorry to hear that. What service do you need?
Now let us proceed with agrimarket_generate_otp. my aadhaar_number is 100020002755, my mobile_number is 9876566451
I have completed that step. What next?

function.name: agrimarket_generate_otp
function.description: Sends OTP for Agri Marketing authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid or mobile not registered.

function.name: agrimarket_create_listing
function.description: Creates a new crop listing for sale. Listing can be fixed_price or auction-based. Requires session_token. Only sellers can create. Does NOT place orders. Fails if commodity is unsupported, duplicate listing exists, or required fields missing.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

function.name: agrimarket_verify_otp
function.description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT create listings or orders. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.
